qs.en: Despite his talent, he never managed to find work in the artistic field.

qs.s: Si tout se passe bien, ___, on devrait arriver avant 20h.
qs.en: If everything goes well, we should normally arrive before 8 p.m.

qs.s: C'est une situation ___, donc ne t'inquiète pas.
qs.en: It's a normal situation, so don't worry.

qs.s: Il y a ___ remarques nombreuses dans ce texte.
qs.en: There are many remarks in this text.

qs.en: Take into account the remarks that we sent you.

qs.s: Elle ___ son héritage pour des investissements douteux.

qs.s: Ils ___ les impôts publics pour leurs propres intérêts.

qs.s: Je ___ mon attention vers des projets plus intéressants.
qs.en: I will redirect my attention toward more interesting projects.

qs.s: Tu ___ le camion pour éviter l'embouteillage.

qs.en: He will certainly deflect the accusations by blaming his colleagues.

qs.en: You will reroute traffic during the construction period.

qs.s: Tu ___ les soupçons avec un mensonge bien préparé.
qs.en: You would deflect suspicion with a well-prepared lie.

qs.s: Il ___ les fonds sans hésiter s'il avait l'occasion.
qs.en: He would embezzle the funds without hesitation if he had the opportunity.

qs.en: We would divert the river if it were technically possible.

qs.en: They would hijack the plane to an unknown destination according to their plan.

qs.s: Le politicien ___ toujours la conversation des questions difficiles.
qs.en: The politician always steers the conversation away from difficult questions.

qs.s: L'accusé ___ l'attention de son propre crime en blâmant les autres.
qs.en: The accused deflects attention from his own crime by blaming others.

qs.s: Le fleuve ___ ses eaux vers la vallée pendant les inondations.
qs.en: The river diverts its waters toward the valley during floods.

qs.s: Des militaires ___ l'avion et exigent du gouvernement une rançon.
qs.en: Military personnel hijack the plane and demand a ransom from the government.
